nfiBuck -- data_processed_github/ sanitization manifest
Run time    : 2026-07-01 14:08:21
Source      : S:/Prosjekter/52106_SFI_SmartForest/optBuck/nfiBuck/data_processed
Destination : S:/Prosjekter/52106_SFI_SmartForest/optBuck/nfiBuck/data_processed_github

=== Privacy policy applied ===
  This data was sanitized for inclusion in the private GitHub repository.
  All estimates derived from this data are SAMPLED ESTIMATES only.
  No NFI expansion factors have been applied.
  No exact plot locations are included.

=== Coordinate column inspection ===
  Result: NO explicit spatial coordinate columns were found in any source
  parquet file (no x, y, lat, lon, easting, northing, UTM, etc.).

=== Original plot identifier handling ===
  Original plot_id (e.g. 'E25159') is an NFI plot code that could be
  reverse-looked-up to an exact sample-plot location in the NFI database.
  Action taken: original plot_id REPLACED by synthetic plot_id_github.
  Synthetic format: P000001, P000002, ... (sorted alphabetically by original).
  The mapping between original and synthetic IDs was created in-memory only
  and was NOT written to disk or committed to the repository.
  Number of unique original plot_ids replaced: 6348

=== Column disposition summary ===
  REPLACED: plot_id       -> plot_id_github (synthetic sequential ID)
  DROPPED:  flateid       (same value as original plot_id; indirect locator)
  DROPPED:  flatenr       (all values = 1; no informational content)
  DROPPED:  hel_delt_flate (all values = 0; no informational content)
  DROPPED:  komnr         (municipality code; finer resolution than needed)
  KEPT:     fylnr         (county code; coarse administrative unit)
  KEPT:     hoh           (elevation metres integer; coarse; not a coordinate)

  Cols dropped ( 17 , including original plot_id): plot_id, hel_delt_flate, treslag, brysth_dia, tslgr, tilv5, flateid, flatenr, komnr, arealtype, areal_anv, abonitet_tre, best_tresl, gran_pr, furu_pr, bjork_pr, lsk_dato

=== Safety verification ===
  'plot_id' absent from tree_plot output  : TRUE
  'plot_id' absent from plots output      : TRUE
  'flateid' absent from tree_plot output  : TRUE
  'flateid' absent from plots output      : TRUE
  'komnr' absent from tree_plot output    : TRUE
  'komnr' absent from plots output        : TRUE
  'plot_id_github' present in both outputs: TRUE

=== Second sanitisation step (roadmap 8, 2026-11-04) ===
  Script   : scripts/sanitize_nfi_table.R (set.seed(20261104))
  DROPPED  : volm, volu, plot_area_m2   (not read by the app; plot_area_m2 was always 250)
  REPLACED : treid (original NFI tree number) -> random permutation of 1..N (integer), so a tree
             cannot be looked up in the NFI database. The old -> new map is kept only in a
             private location outside the repository.
  REPLACED : plot_id_github -> random permutation of the 6348 plot numbers (P000001 ... P006348;
             scripts/permute_plot_ids.R, set.seed(20261105)), because the sequential numbers followed
             the alphabetical order of the original plot codes. The map is kept only in a private
             location outside the repository. The backend's seeded plot sample (n_plots, seed) draws
             from the sorted IDs and now picks other plots; the three sampled NFI baseline cases
             were regenerated on purpose (PLAN.md, Roadmap 8). Runs with all plots are unchanged.
  Rows are no longer in the original tree order (sorted by plot, then new tree number).
  Licence  : CC BY 4.0, attribution "Landsskogtakseringen, NIBIO" (LICENSE-data.md).
  Not rewritten: git history before this commit still holds the original tree numbers and the sequential plot numbers.
